respuesta.pregunta: I'm getting catalog-portfolio-api 0.0.1-test-bench-v2a running on my machine. What MySQL version does it need, and how exactly do I configure the database connection (URL, credentials, which settings to put where) before starting the service?
respuesta.respuesta:
The service needs MySQL 8.0 or higher [catalog-portfolio-api/0.0.1-test-bench-v2a/guide/setup/README.md:L42-L42][catalog-portfolio-api/0.0.1-test-bench-v2a/guide/setup/local-development.md:L11-L11]. In the quick start, database configuration is a step between building the project with `./gradlew build` and running the service with `./gradlew run` [catalog-portfolio-api/0.0.1-test-bench-v2a/guide/setup/README.md:L28-L31][catalog-portfolio-api/0.0.1-test-bench-v2a/guide/setup/README.md:L34-L35].

The documentation doesn't explain how to do that step, though. It doesn't give the connection URL, the credentials, the property names, or which file the settings go in. So I can't tell you how to configure the connection from these docs. All it offers is a way to check connectivity afterwards: run `mysql -h localhost -u your_username -p -e "SELECT 1;"` and check that a `brands_%` database exists [catalog-portfolio-api/0.0.1-test-bench-v2a/guide/troubleshooting/README.md:L34-L40].
